messages:
liz-support: hey team, raised by Sales — SolarWave can't find their API key after following the console onboarding flow. customer sees 'No credentials found' under Project: sw-prod.

sam-devx: ugh. did they create a project first or use the org-level invite?

solarcust-admin: @liz-support we added the org, created a project called sw-prod, clicked 'Create API Key' in the console. the UI showed a spinner for ~10s then returned to the project page with no key displayed. no error toast.

liz-support: thanks. can you share a screencap or the console network logs? also what's the account email?

solarcust-admin: sent a DM with screenshot and email admin@solarwave.io. attaching the console network HAR now.

sam-devx: saw HAR. POST /api/v1/projects/sw-prod/keys returns 201 with body { "id": "key_XXXX", "secret": null } then GET /api/v1/projects/sw-prod/keys returns []. looks like secret is never returned to UI.

onboard-bot: [system] background job key-seal-job queued for project sw-prod (job_id: jb_7821).

ajay-ops: that 201 with null secret is worrying. we intentionally only show secret once at creation. if the secret wasn't captured by the UI client we should still have the secret in the keystore, unless the seal job failed. can you repro via curl?

sam-devx: repro attempt from my laptop using the same user session cookie:

```bash
curl -s -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer session_token_here" 
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/sw-prod/keys | jq
{
  "id": "key_q9v3",
  "secret": null,
  "created_at": "2026-02-12T15:10:30Z"
}
```

sam-devx: then immediate GET returns empty list. repeat request gives new id each time but always secret null.

maria-sre: sounds like the key-creation path is returning before the KMS unwrap completes. check seal-service logs for jb_7821.

ajay-ops: pulling logs now. grep for jb_7821 in seal-service (prod-us-east-1):

```text
2026-02-12T15:10:31Z INFO job queued jb_7821 project=sw-prod
2026-02-12T15:10:31Z ERROR seal-fail job=jb_7821 err="KMS unwrap timeout"
2026-02-12T15:10:31Z WARN retrying job=jb_7821 attempt=1
2026-02-12T15:10:32Z INFO job completed jb_7821 secret_id=sec_9ab4
```

maria-sre: so KMS timed out on first attempt, then completed on retry. UI probably got the 201 before retry finished, hence secret null. backend should block until secret available or return a separate status.

liz-support: customer-facing impact — they never saw the secret value, and we have no way to re-show it. they tried 'Regenerate key' in UI but button is disabled (grayed).

sam-devx: there's a two-part bug: (1) API creates key row immediately with secret=NULL and returns 201 including that row, (2) seal job asynchronously backfills secret. if the UI doesn't poll or show a 'Key pending' state, end user thinks it failed. we can: return 202 Accepted with status pending, or block until seal completes (short timeout), or show a persistent banner.

ajay-ops: short-term patch: we can add a console workaround to show a link to 'Download key later' and enable regen via admin API. but regen is disabled because project-level RBAC flag isn't set for new projects by default — someone flipped a guardrail.

maria-sre: confirming: new projects created by the onboarding flow skip 'allow_key_regen' flag to reduce blast radius. that's why regen is disabled.

liz-support: solarcust-admin — do you have a short-term workaround? we can create a key server-side and DM the secret if you give explicit consent.

solarcust-admin: yes please. we need a key today, internal launch scheduled. yes consented.

sam-devx: creating manual API key from admin CLI now. running:

```bash
redwoodctl keys create --project sw-prod --meta "onboard:manual_support" --ttl 0
```

sam-devx: CLI output shows id=key_manual_1 secret=sk_live_abcdefgh1234. I DM'd the customer. also set allow_key_regen=true for sw-prod so they can regen later.

onboard-bot: [system] manual key created by sam-devx for project sw-prod key=key_manual_1

liz-support: confirmed customer received secret and was able to make test calls. they got 200s to hosted API with the new key. :tada:

maria-sre: long-term: submit RFC to change key creation API to either (A) synchronous sealing with short timeout and return 201+secret, (B) explicitly return 202+operation id and keep UI polling, and (C) set project defaults so regen enabled for new projects created via console. I'll open a ticket.

ajay-ops: I also want an observability alert for 'creation returns secret=null' so we can detect door-step failures. adding a metric on key_creation_secret_missing_count.

sam-devx: filed internal issue DEVX-2318 with repro steps, attached HAR and seal-service logs. tagging @maria-sre and @ajay-ops.

liz-support: closing support loop with SolarWave. cc: @solarcust-admin please re-open if anything else.

solarcust-admin: all good for now. thanks everyone for quick help.

maria-sre: follow-up: I'll propose a safe rollout (202 -> UI poll) and coordinate with devx and security for KMS SLAs.

ajay-ops: one more note — audit shows earlier key rows created during a reattempt window 2026-02-12T15:09:xx that had no operator. looks like double-clicking 'Create' produced two rows; will add idempotency token requirement to API.

sam-devx: good catch. will add idempotency header validation.

liz-support: thanks team. updating the ticket and marking resolved for the customer. :white_check_mark:
